projects.title: Agent Comics
projects.description: An idea becomes a story. A story becomes a comic.
projects.overview: An AI comic-making product that guides people from an initial pitch through story planning and full-page artwork. Users can review the proposed characters and story before generation.
features: An agent helps shape a story idea into characters, beats and pages.
Review and edit the story plan before the artwork is generated.
Character references support consistency across comic pages.
Download completed pages from the iPhone and iPad app.
projects.focus: Generative AI · Story planning · Sequential art
projects.kind: Independent product · iOS app and website
stacks: Guided planning, character references, image generation, downloadable comic pages

projects.title: Garden Home
projects.description: A sense of place, before it exists.
projects.overview: A conceptual residential study developed from an approved ground-floor plan. The project explores furnished interiors, materials, light and room relationships through still images and films.
features: Six interior views rendered in Blender Cycles, available in 4K.
Unreal Engine views for comparing lighting and material treatments.
A 90-second cinematic film introducing the home.
A continuous walkthrough of the furnished ground floor and schematic garden.
projects.kind: Independent visualization study · Stills and films
projects.imageAlt: Garden Home living and dining space rendered in Blender Cycles

projects.title: Email Classifier
projects.description: A clearer inbox, with a little help from AI.
projects.overview: A web application that connects to Gmail with OAuth and categorizes messages using GPT-4o mini. The interface was designed in Figma and built with Next.js and Tailwind.
features: Connect a Gmail account using OAuth.
Categorize emails as important, promotional, spam and other useful groups.
Chain prompts and processing steps with LangChain.
Inspect LLM behavior with LangSmith observability.

projects.title: Product Designer Portfolio
projects.description: A place for a product designer’s work to stand out.
projects.overview: A portfolio website for presenting product design work, built while exploring Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS.
features: A visual presentation of the designer and their work.
Project imagery and descriptions organized in a portfolio layout.

projects.title: Letterio
projects.description: A small space for words worth sharing.
projects.overview: A lightweight website for browsing and sending anonymous letters, built with JavaScript and the Quill rich-text editor.
features: Write anonymous letters using a rich-text editor.
Browse letters shared on the website.

projects.title: Rest Country Display
projects.description: Explore the world, one country at a time.
projects.overview: A React project that presents country information from the REST Countries API. Built while learning React hooks and the SCSS 7-in-1 architecture.
features: Browse country information supplied by the REST Countries API.
Explore a React interface with a color theme switcher.
projects.focus: API integration · React hooks · Styling architecture
